description: This file defines a Java interface named ReadLikelihoodService within the org.apache.fineract.infrastructure.survey.service package. It declares methods for retrieving likelihood data related to surveys, such as retrieving all likelihoods for a given ppiName and retrieving a specific likelihood by its ID.

classes.name: ReadLikelihoodService
classes.description: A Java interface providing methods for accessing likelihood survey data.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of LikelihoodData objects for a given ppiName.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a single LikelihoodData object based on its likelihoodId.
